date_note: The report says the incident began on Sunday; resolved against the article's date of Tuesday 24 November.
exec: Reports say Israeli police suspended systems over information-security concerns; the cause is not yet determined.
plain: Israeli media reports say police switched off several computer systems and an internal messaging app over security worries. It is not yet known whether this was a cyberattack or a technical fault.
summary: Lebanon Debate, relaying an Al Jazeera report that cites an Israeli TV channel and Yedioth Ahronoth, says Israeli police suspended several computer systems and operational applications over information-security concerns. The messaging system Mesernet was disabled and login procedures are being updated. The report says it is still unclear whether this was a cyberattack or an external technical fault, and cites no official police statement.
title: Israeli police reportedly suspend systems over security concerns; cause unclear

validation.note: One publisher (Lebanon Debate relaying Al Jazeera, citing a TV channel and Yedioth Ahronoth); no police statement read.
